author: bardic-inspiration
name: Tourney Champion
summary: A crowd-pleasing jouster whose lance can unhorse a rider and whose bow to the stands is half the fight.
description: The champion has won more bouts in the lists than most knights have fought on a battlefield. A real fight is rougher, but the footwork carries over, and so does the showmanship.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The champion makes two Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Unhorsing Lance
actions.attackNote: with Disadvantage if the target is within 5 feet of the champion
actions.onHit: If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a {dc:str} Strength saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
